title: PABSON / send-up & NEB hard set
blurb: Send-up (SEE Groups) geo+trig drills plus the Class-12 NEB hard set. Cards tagged SEE send-up sit first; Class-12 calculus/algebra follow.

see-heron.name: SEE · Heron area
see-heron.phrase: Group A move: write s = (a+b+c)/2, then area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)].
steps: Add the three sides; divide by 2 for s.
Build s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c).
Take the square root.
see-heron.exception: Triangle inequality first. Using the full perimeter instead of s is the classic send-up trap.

see-elev.name: SEE · Angle of elevation
see-elev.phrase: Send-up heights: sketch, mark elevation θ, then tan θ = opposite/adjacent.
steps: Draw ground line, tower, and sight line from the observer.
Mark θ at the eye looking up.
Usually tan θ = height / distance; solve.
see-elev.exception: Depression is looking down. Don’t use SOHCAHTOA on a non-right figure without dropping a perpendicular.

see-circle.name: SEE · Center & cyclic
see-circle.phrase: Group D circle hooks: center = 2×rim; cyclic opposites sum to 180°.
steps: Same arc: double a rim angle for the center (or halve a central).
Cyclic quad: opposite angles → 180°.
Tangent ⊥ radius when a tangent appears.
see-circle.exception: Rim and center must share the same arc. Adjacent cyclic angles are not forced to 180°.

see-bpt.name: SEE · BPT / similarity
see-bpt.phrase: Parallel cut → equal ratios; AAA → proportional sides.
steps: Spot DE ∥ BC (or equal angles for AAA).
Write AD/DB = AE/EC (BPT) or corresponding sides (similar).
Cross-multiply.
see-bpt.exception: Match corresponding pieces. AAA is similarity, not congruence.

see-soh.name: SEE · SOHCAHTOA drill
see-soh.phrase: Right-triangle send-up: label opp/adj/hyp, then SOH CAH TOA.
steps: Confirm the right angle.
Relative to θ, mark opp, adj, hyp.
Pick the ratio that uses the known and unknown.
see-soh.exception: Oblique triangles need sine/cosine rules — not plain SOHCAHTOA.

perm.name: Permutations nPr
perm.phrase: Order matters: line them up. nPr = n! / (n−r)!.
steps: Ask: does order matter? Yes → permutation.
Write nPr = n! / (n−r)!, or n × (n−1) × … for r factors.
Cancel the unused factorial in the bottom.
perm.exception: If order does not matter (a committee, a set of books), use nCr instead. Also nP0 = 1, and you cannot choose more than n.

comb.name: Combinations nCr
comb.phrase: Order does not matter: bags, not lines. nCr = n! / (r!(n−r)!).
steps: Ask: does order matter? No → combination.
Write nCr = n! / (r!(n−r)!), or nPr / r!.
Use C(n,r) = C(n,n−r) to pick the smaller r.
comb.exception: If seats are numbered or passwords are ordered, use nPr. C(n,0) = C(n,n) = 1. Never leave r! out of the bottom.

binoms.name: Binomial term
binoms.phrase: Pick r of the second factors: C(n,r) aⁿ⁻ʳ bʳ.
steps: Expand (a+b)ⁿ by choosing how many b’s appear: r = 0,1,…,n.
The general term is T_{r+1} = C(n,r) aⁿ⁻ʳ bʳ.
For a specific power of x, set the exponent equal and solve for r.
binoms.exception: The first term is T₁ (r = 0), not T₀. Signs flip when b is negative. Do not forget the binomial coefficient.

logs.name: Log equations
logs.phrase: log asks: what power? Change to exponential, then check the domain.
steps: Rewrite log_b a = c as bᶜ = a.
Use product → sum, quotient → difference, power → front when needed.
Solve, then reject any root that makes a log argument ≤ 0.
logs.exception: Arguments must be positive and bases > 0, ≠ 1. log(A) + log(B) = log(AB) only when both A and B are positive.

matmul.name: Matrix multiply 2×2
matmul.phrase: Row-dot-column: each entry is a row of A dotted with a column of B.
steps: Check sizes: A is m×n, B is n×p → AB is m×p.
Entry (i,j) = row i of A · column j of B.
Write all four entries for 2×2 carefully.
matmul.exception: AB ≠ BA in general. You cannot multiply if the inner sizes disagree. Scalar multiply is entrywise — matrix multiply is not.

det2.name: Determinant 2×2
det2.phrase: Main diagonal product minus other diagonal: ad − bc.
steps: For [[a,b],[c,d]], compute ad − bc.
If det = 0, the matrix is singular (no inverse).
For inverse: (1/det) [[d,−b],[−c,a]].
det2.exception: Do not add the diagonals. Sign of bc is subtracted. For 3×3 use cofactor expansion, not a fake “diagonal rule” without care.

conic.name: Conics quick ID
conic.phrase: Circle x²+y², parabola one square, ellipse both positive, hyperbola opposite signs.
steps: Put the equation in standard-ish form (complete the square if needed).
Both x² and y², same sign, equal coeffs → circle; unequal → ellipse.
Opposite signs → hyperbola. Only one squared variable → parabola.
conic.exception: xy terms rotate axes. Degenerate cases (like x² − y² = 0) factor into lines. Radius squared must be positive for a real circle.

invtrig.name: Inverse trig values
steps: Read the inverse as “the angle in the principal range whose trig is …”.
Use special angles: 0, 30, 45, 60, 90.
Watch the range: arccos(−1/2) is 120°, not −60°.
invtrig.exception: Calculator in radians vs degrees. arcsin and arccos are not defined outside [−1,1]. arctan(−1) is −45°, not 135°.

limits.name: Limits (0/0)
limits.phrase: Plug in first. If 0/0, factor, cancel, then plug in again.
steps: Substitute the approach value.
If you get a number, that is the limit (for a rational with cancelable hole).
If 0/0, factor numerator and denominator, cancel the common (x−a), then substitute.
limits.exception: Canceling changes the function at one point but not the limit. ∞/∞ needs a different tool (divide by highest power). Left and right limits can disagree.

diffapp.name: Max / min with y′
diffapp.phrase: Stationary: y′ = 0. Concavity: y′′ > 0 min, y′′ < 0 max.
steps: Differentiate y to get y′.
Solve y′ = 0 for candidate x-values.
Use y′′ (or first-derivative sign chart) to classify max/min, then find y.
diffapp.exception: Endpoints of a closed interval can be extrema even if y′ ≠ 0. y′ = 0 is necessary on an open set, not always sufficient (flat inflection).

integ.name: Definite integrals
integ.phrase: Antiderivative F, then F(top) − F(bottom). No +C.
steps: Find an antiderivative F of the integrand.
Evaluate F(b) − F(a) for ∫_a^b.
Simplify the number (fraction OK).
integ.exception: Do not add C on a definite integral. If you substitute, change the limits. Absolute value for ∫1/x when crossing 0 is subtle — avoid that case here.

de1.name: Separable DEs
de1.phrase: dy/dx = f(x)g(y) → pile y’s with dy, x’s with dx, then integrate.
steps: Rewrite so g(y) dy and f(x) dx sit on opposite sides (or  dy/g = f dx).
Integrate both sides.
Solve for y if asked; keep +C.
de1.exception: Dividing by g(y) loses solutions where g(y)=0 — check constant solutions. Not every DE is separable.

prob.name: Probability basics
steps: List the sample space size when outcomes are equally likely.
For “or”, add and subtract the overlap.
For independent “and”, multiply the probabilities.
prob.exception: Mutually exclusive means P(A∩B)=0 — then just add. Independent is not the same as mutually exclusive. Probabilities stay in [0,1].

binomprob.name: Binomial probability
binomprob.phrase: C(n,k) pᵏ (1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ: choose who succeeds, then multiply.
steps: Confirm n independent trials, success probability p each time.
Choose which k trials succeed: C(n,k).
Multiply by pᵏ (1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ.
binomprob.exception: Not for dependent trials. “At least one” is often 1 − P(none). p is success probability, not a count.

vectors.name: Vector length & dot
steps: Magnitude: square, add, root.
Dot: multiply matching components and add.
Perpendicular ⇔ dot product 0.
vectors.exception: Dot product is a scalar, not a vector. |a+b| ≠ |a|+|b| in general. Unit vector is a/|a|, not 1/a componentwise without care.

projectile.name: Projectile range
steps: Resolve: uₓ = u cos θ, uᵧ = u sin θ.
Time of flight 2 u sinθ / g; range = uₓ × time = u² sin2θ / g.
sin2θ max at 2θ=90° → θ=45°.
projectile.exception: Formula assumes flat ground and no air resistance. Complementary angles θ and 90°−θ share the same range. Height uses a different formula.

statics.name: Statics: resolve forces
statics.phrase: ΣFₓ = 0 and ΣFᵧ = 0 for equilibrium. Resolve into components.
steps: Draw a free-body diagram.
Resolve every force into x and y: F cosθ, F sinθ.
Set sum of components in each direction to zero; solve.
statics.exception: Moments: Στ = 0 about a point if rotation can occur. Signs for direction must stay consistent. Weight acts at the center of mass.

newtonraphson.name: Newton–Raphson idea
newtonraphson.phrase: Next guess: x₁ = x₀ − f(x₀)/f′(x₀). Tangent hits the axis.
steps: Start with a rough root guess x₀.
Compute f(x₀) and f′(x₀).
Update x₁ = x₀ − f(x₀)/f′(x₀); repeat.
newtonraphson.exception: Fails if f′(x₀)=0 (horizontal tangent). Bad guesses can diverge. This finds a root of f(x)=0, not a maximum.

partial.name: Partial fractions setup
partial.phrase: Factor the bottom; linear factors get A/(x−r), repeats get A/(x−r)+B/(x−r)².
steps: Factor the denominator completely.
Write a template: each distinct linear factor gets a constant over it.
Clear denominators and solve for the constants by substituting roots or equating coeffs.
partial.exception: If the top degree ≥ bottom degree, divide first (polynomial + proper fraction). Irreducible quadratics need (Bx+C)/(quadratic).

chainhard.name: Chain rule in exams
chainhard.phrase: Outside derivative, times inside derivative: f′(g(x)) · g′(x).
steps: Name the outside function and the inside.
Differentiate the outside, leave the inside alone.
Multiply by the inside’s derivative.
chainhard.exception: Forgetting to multiply by the inside derivative is the classic error. Products of two composite functions need product + chain.

areaunder.name: Area under a curve
areaunder.phrase: Area = ∫_a^b y dx when y ≥ 0. Below the axis, take absolute value.
steps: Sketch or check the sign of y on [a,b].
Integrate to get a signed area.
If the curve crosses the axis, split the integral at roots.
areaunder.exception: A single integral from a to b gives net signed area — cancellations happen. For total geometric area, split where y=0.

seqseries.name: AP / GP exam moves
seqseries.phrase: AP: a+(n−1)d. GP: arⁿ⁻¹. Sum AP n/2(2a+(n−1)d); GP a(rⁿ−1)/(r−1).
steps: Identify arithmetic (common difference) or geometric (common ratio).
Write the nth term formula.
Use the matching sum formula; for |r|<1 infinite GP, S=a/(1−r).
seqseries.exception: GP sum formula changes for r=1 (then S=na). Infinite sum needs |r|<1. Do not mix AP and GP formulas.

complex.name: Complex numbers i
complex.phrase: i² = −1. Multiply like binomials; replace i² with −1.
steps: Write z = a + bi.
Add/subtract components; multiply with FOIL then i²→−1.
Modulus |z|=√(a²+b²); conjugate a−bi.
complex.exception: i³ = −i, i⁴ = 1 — reduce powers mod 4. Division: multiply by the conjugate of the bottom. √(−1) is i, not a real.
